Volume 4 is the fourth and final omnibus volume of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. It was published by Shogakukan Asia in , although it uses VIZ Media's translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in and (excluding PS268 and PS269, which are part of the ).

==Major events==
 
Wallace becomes the champion of the Elite Four.
The Red Orb and the Blue Orb are forced out of Maxie and Archie.
awakens the legendary giants.
and go to .
Ruby realizes that he and Sapphire have the Red and Blue Orbs inside them.
Sapphire defeats Tate, Liza, and Juan.
Ruby and Sapphire leave Mirage Island.
awakens , and Norman heads with it to Sootopolis City.
Ruby reveals he was the boy Sapphire met five years ago.
Courtney dies from being buried under a rockslide after being dragged into the Cave of Origin.
Norman and meet the same fate after quelling the giants due to the strain of controlling the powerful legends.
The reasons for Norman's banning from taking the Gym Leader test are revealed, as are many details regarding 's past history with him.
Maxie and Archie return and, after badly wounding Wallace by taking Winona hostage, are eventually defeated by the combined efforts of Ruby and .
is able to take back the Red and Blue Orbs and use its time travel powers to alter the course of events, reviving Courtney, Steven, and Norman.
Both Ruby and Sapphire are able to meet the deadline on their respective challenges and return to Littleroot Town, where Ruby's delayed birthday party is celebrated together with Sapphire's birthday.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Ruby's Plusle, in PS256.
Sapphire's Minun, in PS256. 

===Evolutions===
Sapphire's "Rono" evolves into in PS256.
Ruby's "Rara" evolves into in PS258.
Ruby's "Feefee" evolves into in PS266.

===Other===
releases Celebi in PS267.

==Gym battles==
Sapphire defeats Tate and Liza together with Ruby in PS257.
Sapphire defeats Juan in PS257.
Sapphire defeats Norman in PS267.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby wins Master Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS267.
